literature.title: MedMNIST v2 - A large-scale lightweight benchmark for 2D and 3D biomedical image classification

literature.label: published ResNet-18 (224), fully supervised (Yang et al. 2023)

datasets.name: pathmnist
datasets.modality: haematoxylin-and-eosin-stained colorectal histology patches, 3-channel colour, 224 x 224 pixels at about 0.5 microns per pixel

datasets.name: dermamnist
datasets.modality: 3-channel colour dermatoscopic images of pigmented skin lesions

datasets.name: octmnist
datasets.modality: 1-channel greyscale retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) B-scans

datasets.name: pneumoniamnist
datasets.source_dataset: Paediatric chest X-ray collection (Kermany et al. 2018)

datasets.name: bloodmnist
datasets.modality: three-channel colour microscopy images of individual normal peripheral-blood cells, May-Grunwald-Giemsa stained, captured on a CellaVision DM96 analyser
datasets.source_dataset: Peripheral blood cell images, Hospital Clinic of Barcelona (Acevedo et al. 2020)

datasets.name: organamnist
datasets.modality: 1-channel greyscale abdominal CT crops at a fixed abdominal window; each image is a 2D bounding-box crop around one organ taken from a CT volume in the axial plane
datasets.source_dataset: Liver Tumor Segmentation Benchmark, LiTS (Bilic et al. 2023), with the eleven-organ bounding-box annotations of Xu et al. 2019

datasets.name: breastmnist
datasets.source_dataset: BUSI, Breast Ultrasound Images (Al-Dhabyani et al. 2020)

datasets.name: tissuemnist
datasets.modality: greyscale 2D projections of segmented single cells from 3D confocal fluorescence microscopy of nuclear-stained human kidney cortex

datasets.name: organcmnist
datasets.modality: 1-channel greyscale abdominal CT crops at a fixed abdominal window; each image is a 2D bounding-box crop around one organ taken from a CT volume in the coronal plane
datasets.source_dataset: Liver Tumor Segmentation Benchmark, LiTS (Bilic et al. 2023), with the eleven-organ bounding-box annotations of Xu et al. 2019

datasets.name: organsmnist
datasets.modality: 1-channel greyscale abdominal CT crops at a fixed abdominal window; each image is a 2D bounding-box crop around one organ taken from a CT volume in the sagittal plane
datasets.source_dataset: Liver Tumor Segmentation Benchmark, LiTS (Bilic et al. 2023), with the eleven-organ bounding-box annotations of Xu et al. 2019

verdicts.title: Substitution
verdicts.question: Are textbook features worth a measurable number of labelled images?
verdicts.rule: median n_B ≥ 100 over the eleven arm-B datasets AND AUC(C) > AUC(P) at n = 50 on at least 10 of the 12 datasets (p < 0.05)

verdicts.title: The bank, not just the model
verdicts.question: Does directing the model at cited visual features beat asking for the diagnosis?
verdicts.rule: AUC(B) > AUC(A) on at least 9 of the 11 arm-B datasets (p < 0.05)

verdicts.title: Scale
verdicts.question: Does the prior get better with a bigger model?
verdicts.rule: the larger model has the higher AUC(B) on at least 9 of 11 datasets in BOTH families (p < 0.05)

verdicts.title: Reading
verdicts.question: Does a better reader get more class information out of the same images?
verdicts.rule: each step — effort, then capability — wins on at least 9 of the 11 arm-B datasets (p < 0.05)

verdicts.title: Complement
verdicts.question: Does the textbook add anything the pixels do not already carry?
verdicts.rule: AUC(C+P) > AUC(P) at n = 50 on at least 10 of the 12 datasets (p < 0.05)

verdicts.title: Effort in the frontier model
verdicts.question: Is H4b's null about the model, or about how hard it was asked to think?
verdicts.rule: gpt-5.6-terra at low beats the same model at medium on at least 9 of the 11 arm-B datasets (p < 0.05)

verdicts.title: Capability inside the frontier family
verdicts.question: Does a more capable closed model read cited features better?
verdicts.rule: gpt-5.6-sol beats gpt-5.6-luna, both at low, on at least 9 of the 11 arm-B datasets (p < 0.05)
verdicts.metric: probe AUC, top of the price ladder over bottom

catches.what: An unfair pixel baseline that would have made the headline claim true by construction
Four generated rules that all ran the last model's command
3,000 good answers filed under a third response field and recorded as missing
A 48-job wave that ran two hours and wrote nothing
Thinking believed impossible, when the cause was our own 512-token budget
A second session switching the shared checkout onto its own branch mid-run
An eleven-chunk thinking wave that would have died at its time limit
catches.caught_by: one chunk run first, and a timed call
